Kaplan & Sadock Synopsis.note: Re-uploaded 2026-08-20 and the Drive problem IS fixed: add-drive now returns rc=0 with type=pdf and no transport timeout, and drive_status reads 'active', is_drive_degraded false. NotebookLM still puts it in `error` during indexing, with no reason given, so the file is now readable but not ingestible - most likely over the per-source size limit at ~1500 pages of dense two-column text, where the five books that do index run 502-1156 pages. Splitting it in two would test that. Left disabled: it is the supplementary source, used only where Dulcan has no chapter.

StahlKids.drive_title: Copy of Stahls Essential Psychopharmacology Prescribers Guide - Children and Adolescents (1).pdf
StahlKids.why_this_name: Both Stahl books were labelled with a shared 'Stahl ' prefix, so the model wrote bare 'Stahl p. 761' and no reader - human or code - could tell which of the two was meant. These names share no separable prefix, so 'Stahl' alone is never a valid citation label and is detectable as an error on sight.
